title: Fase 2 demand sampler integration check

source_rebuild.method: Regenerated with generate_phase2_profiles.py from the three attached workbooks using only four aggregate input fields: urg_fecha_hora, tri_fecha_hora, urg_fecha_egreso, niv_cod.

sampler.count_model: Poisson per comparable calendar-day hour (assumption; requires empirical validation)
sampler.within_hour_model: Uniform over integer minutes 0-59 (assumption; requires empirical validation)
sampler.severity_default: Smoothed C1-C5 proportions from the selected month/day-type/hour cell
sampler.reproducibility: Seeded independently by master_seed, replication_id, hour key, and stream; stable synthetic patient IDs.

limitations: Pooled 2016-2018 historical demand grew 42.9% across the observed years; current-demand validity is not established.
Poisson hourly counts and uniform minute placement are explicit assumptions, not observed empirical facts.
Severity is sampled from aggregate historical proportions; no pre-trained ESI classifier is invoked because its synthetic input contract has not yet been validated.
Observed arrival-to-triage and arrival-to-discharge intervals are not treated as pure service durations.
privacy: This report contains aggregate counts and file hashes only; no patient-level rows or identifiers.
